description: Header file declaring utility functions and constants for Metal rendering in ANGLE project, including shader creation, enum conversions, and graphics state utilities.

methods.name: InitializeTextureContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of a texture in the Metal context.

methods.name: GetViewport
methods.description: Calculates a Metal viewport from a rectangle and depth range.

methods.name: GetViewportFlipY
methods.description: Calculates a Metal viewport with Y-axis flipped.

methods.name: GetScissorRect
methods.description: Calculates a Metal scissor rectangle from a rectangle.

methods.name: CreateShaderLibrary
methods.description: Creates a Metal shader library from source code.

methods.name: CreateShaderLibraryFromBinary
methods.description: Creates a Metal shader library from binary source.

methods.name: GetTextureType
methods.description: Converts OpenGL texture type to Metal texture type.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Converts GLenum filter to Metal filter.

methods.name: GetMipmapFilter
methods.description: Converts GLenum filter to Metal mipmap filter.

methods.name: GetSamplerAddressMode
methods.description: Converts GLenum wrap mode to Metal sampler address mode.

methods.name: GetBlendFactor
methods.description: Converts GLenum blend factor to Metal blend factor.

methods.name: GetBlendOp
methods.description: Converts GLenum blend operation to Metal blend operation.

methods.name: GetCompareFunc
methods.description: Converts GLenum compare function to Metal compare function.

methods.name: GetStencilOp
methods.description: Converts GLenum stencil operation to Metal stencil operation.

methods.name: GetFontfaceWinding
methods.description: Converts front face mode to Metal winding, with optional inversion.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveTopologyClass
methods.description: Gets the primitive topology class for a given primitive mode.

methods.name: GetPrimitiveType
methods.description: Converts primitive mode to Metal primitive type.

methods.name: GetIndexType
methods.description: Converts OpenGL draw element type to Metal index type.

methods.name: EmulatedAlphaClearColor
methods.description: Adjusts clear color to emulate alpha for textures without alpha channel.
